request_entry.description: RCX=H; EDX=op; R8D=slot; R9B=system; H+38 gate

request_exit.description: common request return; do not infer success from volatile return register

queue_pop_entry.description: RCX=R; removes/frees first queued snapshot before async write

snapshot_ready.description: RSI=snapshot; checksum computed; before unlocking snapshot mutex

snapshot_copy_entry.description: RCX=staging; RDX=queued snapshot; snapshot mutex acquired within

worker_start.description: worker thunk selects active task from global

serializer_copyback.description: RCX=source staging; RDX=transformed temporary; R8=bytes; before memcpy

serializer_exit.description: RSI=S; RDI=output; EBX=error code; output wiped on error

writer_entry.description: RCX=dir; RDX=name; R8=buffer; R9=bytes; stack+28=error ptr

writer_open_result.description: RAX=open handle; R14=dir; R13=name; R15=buffer; RDI=size

writer_exit.description: AL=success; RBX=error ptr; common early/success return epilogue

completion_consume.description: RBX=H; before H+38 cleared and active task finalized

read_entry.description: RCX=read task; reads file, transforms payload and reports task error

read_exit.description: RSI=read task; AL=success at common epilogue

apply_entry.description: RCX=character payload; applies objects before final checksum comparison

apply_exit.description: AL=checksum equality after object mutation; common epilogue
